mapper.sql: SELECT a.id,a.admin_case_id case_id,r.relation_id issue_id,a.target_id order_id,a.action_status status, a.request_payload_json payload,a.planned_rent_refund_amount_fen rent,a.planned_deposit_refund_amount_fen deposit, a.planned_freight_refund_amount_fen freight,COALESCE(a.request_payload_json->>'$.scheme_version',1) scheme_version, (a.result_payload_json->>'$.termination.first_refund_submit_started_at' IS NOT NULL OR a.result_payload_json->>'$.termination.financial_finalized_at' IS NOT NULL OR a.action_status='succeeded') locked FROM admin_case_action a JOIN admin_case_relation r ON r.admin_case_id=a.admin_case_id AND r.is_primary=1 AND r.relation_type='order_issue_report'
mapper.select: WHERE a.id=#{id} AND a.action_type='resolve_order_issue' AND a.operator_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL

WHERE a.target_type='rental_order' AND a.target_id=#{orderId} AND a.action_type='resolve_order_issue' AND a.parent_action_id IS NULL AND a.operator_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND a.action_status IN ('executing','failed','succeeded') AND r.relation_id=#{issueId} AND a.request_payload_json->>'$.fulfillment_decision'='terminate'

SELECT a.payment_channel_suborder_id suborder_id, a.rent_allocated_amount_fen-COALESCE(r.rent,0) rent,a.deposit_allocated_amount_fen-COALESCE(r.deposit,0) deposit, a.freight_prepaid_allocated_fen-COALESCE(r.freight,0) freight, a.rent_allocated_amount_fen original_rent,a.deposit_allocated_amount_fen original_deposit,a.freight_prepaid_allocated_fen original_freight FROM payment_allocation a JOIN payment_channel_suborder s ON s.id=a.payment_channel_suborder_id AND s.payment_status='success' AND s.rental_order_id=a.rental_order_id AND s.paid_amount_fen=a.total_allocated_amount_fen JOIN payment_order p ON p.id=s.payment_order_id AND p.payment_scene IN ('initial_order','extension_rent') LEFT JOIN order_extension_request ext ON ext.payment_order_id=p.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT payment_channel_suborder_id,SUM(rent_refund_amount_fen) rent,SUM(deposit_refund_amount_fen) deposit, SUM(freight_refund_amount_fen) freight FROM refund_order WHERE rental_order_id=#{orderId} AND refund_status!='cancelled' AND id NOT IN (SELECT target_id FROM admin_case_action WHERE parent_action_id=#{excludeAction} AND target_type='refund_order') GROUP BY payment_channel_suborder_id) r ON r.payment_channel_suborder_id=s.id WHERE a.rental_order_id=#{orderId} AND (p.payment_scene='initial_order' OR ext.extension_status='approved') ORDER BY s.paid_at,s.id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(IF(fund_component='rent',amount_fen,0)),0) rent, COALESCE(SUM(IF(fund_component='deposit',amount_fen,0)),0) deposit, COALESCE((SELECT online_settle_amount_fen FROM rental_order_freight_account WHERE rental_order_id=#{orderId}),0) freight FROM order_deduction WHERE rental_order_id=#{orderId} AND deduction_status IN ('pending','confirmed') AND NOT (source_type='admin_case_action' AND source_id=#{excludeAction})

SELECT r.id refund_id,r.refund_status status,r.refund_amount_fen amount_fen FROM admin_case_action a JOIN refund_order r ON a.target_id=r.id AND a.target_type='refund_order' WHERE a.parent_action_id=#{actionId} ORDER BY a.step_no
mapper.sql: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_outbound_record WHERE rental_order_id=${orderRef} AND (outbound_status='completed' OR outbound_at IS NOT NULL OR dispatch_at IS NOT NULL)) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_receipt_check WHERE rental_order_id=${orderRef}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inventory_reservation WHERE rental_order_id=${orderRef} AND reservation_status IN ('renting','overdue_holding','disputed_holding'))
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_claim WHERE rental_order_id=#{order} AND claim_status NOT IN ('draft','withdrawn','closed','rejected')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arbitration_case WHERE rental_order_id=#{order} AND case_status NOT IN ('closed','cancelled'))
mapper.sql: EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_return_check WHERE rental_order_id=${orderRef} AND checked_at IS NOT NULL AND operator_user_id IS NOT NULL AND closed_at IS NOT NULL AND check_status='no_issue')
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_extension_request WHERE active_order_guard=#{orderId})

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_case_relation WHERE admin_case_id=#{caseId} AND relation_type=#{type} AND relation_id=#{id}) OR (#{type}='rental_order' AND #{id}=#{orderId}) OR (#{type}='order_evidence_record' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_evidence_record WHERE id=#{id} AND rental_order_id=#{orderId} AND draft_removed_at IS NULL))
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_order r JOIN admin_case_action a ON a.target_type='refund_order' AND a.target_id=r.id SET r.refund_status='cancelled',r.next_attempt_at=NULL,r.updated_at=#{at},r.version=r.version+1 WHERE a.parent_action_id=#{actionId} AND r.refund_status='pending' AND r.attempt_count=0

UPDATE admin_case_action SET action_status='cancelled',updated_at=#{at},result_payload_json=JSON_SET( COALESCE(result_payload_json,JSON_OBJECT()),'$.superseded_by',#{replacement}) WHERE id=#{id} OR parent_action_id=#{id}

UPDATE order_deduction SET deduction_status='cancelled',confirmed_at=NULL,cancelled_at=#{at},updated_at=#{at} WHERE source_type='admin_case_action' AND source_id=#{id} AND deduction_status IN ('pending','confirmed')
UPDATE order_deduction SET deduction_status='confirmed',confirmed_at=#{at},updated_at=#{at} WHERE source_type='admin_case_action' AND source_id=#{actionId} AND deduction_status='pending'

UPDATE rental_order o SET deposit_deducted_amount_fen=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_fen),0) FROM order_deduction d WHERE d.rental_order_id=o.id AND d.fund_component='deposit' AND d.deduction_status='confirmed'), deposit_status=CASE WHEN deposit_paid_amount_fen=0 THEN 'settled' WHEN deposit_refunded_amount_fen=deposit_paid_amount_fen THEN 'refunded' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM refund_order r WHERE r.rental_order_id=o.id AND r.deposit_refund_amount_fen>0 AND r.refund_status NOT IN ('success','cancelled')) THEN 'refunding' WHEN deposit_deducted_amount_fen+deposit_refunded_amount_fen=deposit_paid_amount_fen THEN 'settled' WHEN deposit_deducted_amount_fen>0 THEN 'partially_deducted' ELSE 'paid' END, total_deducted_amount_fen=(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_fen),0) FROM order_deduction d WHERE d.rental_order_id=o.id AND d.deduction_status='confirmed'), updated_at=#{at},version=version+1 WHERE o.id=#{orderId}
UPDATE order_return_check SET auto_close_at=NULL,version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE rental_order_id=#{orderId} AND closed_at IS NULL AND auto_close_at IS NOT NULL

UPDATE rental_order SET order_status='cancelled',cancel_type='admin_intervention',cancelled_at=COALESCE(cancelled_at,#{at}),updated_at=#{at},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{orderId} AND order_status IN ('accepted','fulfilling','return_checking')
UPDATE admin_case_action SET action_status='succeeded',executed_at=#{at},updated_at=#{at} WHERE parent_action_id=#{id} AND action_status='executing'
UPDATE order_issue_report SET issue_status='resolved',resolved_at=#{at},updated_at=#{at},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{issueId} AND issue_status='processing'

UPDATE admin_case SET case_status='closed',active_case_key=NULL,closed_at=#{at},closed_by_admin_user_id=#{actor},updated_at=#{at},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{caseId} AND case_status NOT IN ('closed','cancelled')
mapper.select: SELECT parent_action_id FROM admin_case_action WHERE target_type='refund_order' AND target_id=#{refundId} AND action_type='issue_refund' AND parent_action_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE refund_order SET refund_status='processing',updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{refundId} AND refund_status='pending'

UPDATE admin_case_action a SET result_payload_json=JSON_SET(result_payload_json, '$.termination.first_refund_submit_started_at',CAST(#{at} AS CHAR),'$.termination.locked_version',request_payload_json->'$.scheme_version', '$.termination.refund_ids',(SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(s.target_id) FROM (SELECT parent_action_id,target_id FROM admin_case_action WHERE target_type='refund_order' GROUP BY parent_action_id,target_id) s WHERE s.parent_action_id=a.id)), updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{actionId} AND request_payload_json->>'$.fulfillment_decision'='terminate' AND result_payload_json->>'$.termination.first_refund_submit_started_at' IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT target_id FROM admin_case_action WHERE action_type='resolve_order_issue' AND parent_action_id IS NULL AND action_status IN ('executing','failed') AND target_id>#{afterId} ORDER BY target_id LIMIT 100
